source.title: How Swissbit Upleveled Its Operational Efficiency with Salesforce

source_facts.fact: Quoting and fulfillment use customer-specific agreements, including projects that last for years.
Reseller partners register projects and track them as opportunities until conversion.
The customer platform integrates sales and transactional data with an ERP system.
Sales users track orders through shipping details and tracking number.
Combined operational and sales data supports forecasting and capacity planning.

validation_extensions.scenario: Conflicting synthetic partner registrations enter review without leaking the other partner's commercial data.
Historical orders retain their agreement version while new quotes use the effective version.
Concurrent ERP retries converge on one logical order in each system.
Reconciliation recovers a remotely created ERP order after callback loss.
Duplicate and out-of-order shipment events never regress delivered status.
A forecast snapshot can be rebuilt without mutating transaction facts.

synthetic_data_policy: Use fictional partners, agreements, products, orders, tracking numbers, and ERP payloads; do not reproduce customer or reseller records.
